notes.title: Thank you for joining us at Gamescom!
notes.notes:
[p]Gamescom, what an event! We exhibited Monuments to Ruin for the first time publicly at the Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom last week and what a great event it was. We got to meet many of you and would just like to say thank you for all the great feedback and many hours spent building up vast fortifications! [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645169/67ba50be046084b119c9a8e116fb17bd45651c52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Some of you also joined our [url="https://discord.gg/KVfY6kXyTh"]Discord[/url] which we can highly recommend as that is where we will be most active, sharing development tidbits and announcing things like public playtests but more about that below. [/p][p][/p][h2]Looking forward[/h2][p]We had many great meetings with publishers during Gamescom so let’s see if anything comes of that. We are currently doing all the post-Gamescom followups and getting over the usual convention plague but then we are back in full production, working on many new exciting features. Features that we would love to get your feedback on. We are planning on doing a public playtest around the end of September so stay tuned for more news on that.  [/p][p][/p][h2]More goodness![/h2][p]We got to try many of our fellow dev's great games at the Indie Arena Booth and we want to highlight two. If you like Tower Defence games and need something to tide you over until Monuments to Ruin is released we can highly recommend Tempest Tower! It just released two weeks ago and you can play it right now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123800/Tempest_Tower/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][p]If you can wait a bit longer we can also highly recommend Dawn Of Defense, another Tower Defense game but with RTS elements! Definitely one to add to your wishlists!

[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781660/Dawn_Of_Defense/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Monumets to Ruin goes Gamescom!
notes.notes: [p]It's been just a few weeks since we announced the game officially. Now we are going to Gamescom and it will be the first time Monuments to Ruin will be publicly playable! [/p][p]You can find us at the Indie Arena Booth in Hall 10.2 as part of the Swissgames delegation from August 20th-24th. We are really excited to meet you all and have you try the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645169/a0ab55fa2cd8afb8eb15f65a463a46ff8b19d9ca.png"][/img][/p]
